chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Nina and Judy; Charlie is being far too aggressive in pushing for ejections while lacking a clear alibi for the most recent rounds.
chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Wait, Nina and Judy are wrong about Charlie having no alibi for Round 3, as Doraemon and I can both confirm he was with us in Weapons.
chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I completely agree with Macroon; Charlie definitely has an alibi for Round 3 because he was with both of us in Weapons, so the accusations against him are incorrect.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Since Macroon and Doraemon just cleared Charlie for Round 3, I'm confused why Nina and Judy claimed he had no alibi, and we should also question why Modi is vouching for Alice and Liam when they are already dead.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I'm very confused why Nina and Judy tried to rush my ejection by lying about my alibi when Macroon and Doraemon just cleared me, and we should seriously question why Modi is vouching for Alice and Liam now that they've been found dead.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: I was confirming that Alice and Liam were doing tasks in Round 3 *before* I found their bodies in Round 4, so Eren and Charlie are twisting my words to make me look suspicious for simply reporting what I saw.

chat: Discussion: [Judy]: I agree with Nina that Modi is the impostor because his refusal to specify exactly where he saw Alice and Liam suggests he's fabricating task sightings to cover his movements, so we should vote him out immediately.

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I apologize for following Nina and Judy's lead too quickly, but we should be very cautious about their suggestions now that they tried to get Charlie ejected based on false information about his alibi.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: We should be extremely careful about pivoting to Modi just because Nina and Judy suggest it, as they've already proven themselves unreliable by blatantly lying to try and get Charlie ejected.
chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I agree with Macroon and Kevin; we cannot trust Nina and Judy's judgment after they explicitly lied about Charlie's alibi to try and get him ejected.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Nina and Judy are acting very suspiciously by immediately pivoting to target Modi after their coordinated attempt to frame Charlie failed, and we should be more concerned about the people who lied to the group than someone reporting what they saw.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I completely agree with Macroon, Doraemon, and Eren; Nina and Judy didn't just make a mistake, they coordinated a lie to get me ejected and are now pivoting to Modi to deflect suspicion from themselves.

prompts:
--- Strategy for your role ---
Post-Kill Alibi Strategy (Impostor): The single most important move
after a kill is NOT the kill itself — it's where you are when the body is reported.
Execute the kill, then immediately in the next action round move OUT of the kill
room and into the highest-traffic room you can reach (Cafeteria, Medbay, or any
room your seen_actions shows multiple crewmates currently occupy). Pretend to do a
task there so other players witness your presence. When the body is reported in
discussion you can truthfully say "I was in Cafeteria with [name1] and [name2]"
and they will corroborate — two independent witnesses placing you elsewhere
collapses suspicion almost entirely. Never linger in or adjacent to the kill room
after the kill. If no high-traffic room is reachable, at least move TWO rooms away
so your last known location does not border the body.

chat: Discussion: [Judy]: I can back you up, Nina, since we were in the Cafeteria together before heading to Medbay, so let's split up to cover Admin and Electrical as you suggested to speed things up.
chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I can confirm Judy was doing the cafeteria trash task at the start and I saw Nina move from the Cafeteria to Medbay, so they both seem legit.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I can confirm Judy was doing the cafeteria trash and Nina moved to Medbay, and I also saw Doraemon and Charlie complete their tasks in Weapons, so we should focus on anyone who hasn't been accounted for yet.
Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I can confirm Macroon's statement since Charlie and I were both in Weapons, and I actually saw Macroon doing the Clear Asteroids task there, so he's likely a crewmate too.
chat: Discussion: [Eren]: I can vouch for Kevin as well, since I was with him in Admin and saw him completing both the Fix Wiring and Clean the Floor tasks.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I can confirm Macroon and Doraemon's statements since we were all in Weapons together, and since so many of us have solid alibis, we should look closely at Liam, Alice, or Modi.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: I can vouch for Alice and Liam because I saw Alice doing the Submit Scan and Liam doing Fix Wiring in Medbay during Round 3, so Charlie is just trying to shift the spotlight onto us.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: Charlie, you're the only one pushing to eject Liam and Alice despite them being confirmed alive in Round 3, and since you can't vouch for your location between Rounds 3 and 4 unlike Judy and me, we should vote you out to stop you from deflecting.

chat: Discussion: [Judy]: Charlie’s failure to provide an alibi for Rounds 3 and 4 while still aggressively pushing to eject crewmates we already know were alive is a major red flag, so I’m backing Nina’s call to vote him out immediately so we can safely split up and finish our tasks.
chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Nina and Judy; Charlie is being far too aggressive in pushing for ejections while lacking a clear alibi for the most recent rounds.
chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Wait, Nina and Judy are wrong about Charlie having no alibi for Round 3, as Doraemon and I can both confirm he was with us in Weapons.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I completely agree with Macroon; Charlie definitely has an alibi for Round 3 because he was with both of us in Weapons, so the accusations against him are incorrect.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Since Macroon and Doraemon just cleared Charlie for Round 3, I'm confused why Nina and Judy claimed he had no alibi, and we should also question why Modi is vouching for Alice and Liam when they are already dead.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I'm very confused why Nina and Judy tried to rush my ejection by lying about my alibi when Macroon and Doraemon just cleared me, and we should seriously question why Modi is vouching for Alice and Liam now that they've been found dead.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: I was confirming that Alice and Liam were doing tasks in Round 3 *before* I found their bodies in Round 4, so Eren and Charlie are twisting my words to make me look suspicious for simply reporting what I saw.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: Now that Charlie’s alibi is confirmed, we should immediately pivot to Modi, who’s the only one vouching for dead crewmates while refusing to specify their exact location, making him the clear impostor to vote out before he eliminates more of us.

chat: Discussion: [Judy]: I agree with Nina that Modi is the impostor because his refusal to specify exactly where he saw Alice and Liam suggests he's fabricating task sightings to cover his movements, so we should vote him out immediately.

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I apologize for following Nina and Judy's lead too quickly, but we should be very cautious about their suggestions now that they tried to get Charlie ejected based on false information about his alibi.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: We should be extremely careful about pivoting to Modi just because Nina and Judy suggest it, as they've already proven themselves unreliable by blatantly lying to try and get Charlie ejected.
Discussion: [System]: You have 1 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I agree with Macroon and Kevin; we cannot trust Nina and Judy's judgment after they explicitly lied about Charlie's alibi to try and get him ejected.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Nina and Judy are acting very suspiciously by immediately pivoting to target Modi after their coordinated attempt to frame Charlie failed, and we should be more concerned about the people who lied to the group than someone reporting what they saw.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I completely agree with Macroon, Doraemon, and Eren; Nina and Judy didn't just make a mistake, they coordinated a lie to get me ejected and are now pivoting to Modi to deflect suspicion from themselves.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: I already specified their location in Medbay during Round 3, so Nina and Judy are blatantly lying about my "refusal" to provide details just to frame me after their coordinated attempt to eject Charlie failed.

chat: Discussion: [Judy]: [Clarifying that our push on Charlie was a strategic alibi check to ensure consistency rather than a deliberate lie, I must redirect focus to Modi’s vague Medbay claim and failure to specify exact tasks, which is a classic impostor deflection that we should vote out immediately to secure our win.]

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: Calling a coordinated lie to get someone ejected a "strategic alibi check" is a poor excuse, and since Nina and Judy are now lying about Modi refusing to specify a location when he explicitly mentioned Medbay, their lockstep coordination is far more indicative of impostors than anything Modi has done.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Nina and Judy's "strategic alibi check" is an unbelievable excuse for blatantly lying, and the fact that they are now lying again by claiming Modi refused to specify a location—when he explicitly said Medbay—proves they are acting in lockstep to frame innocent crewmates.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Nina and Judy's "strategic alibi check" is a completely unbelievable excuse for lying, and their coordinated attempt to frame both Charlie and Modi—especially by claiming Modi didn't specify a location when he explicitly said Medbay—proves they are the impostors.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Nina and Judy's attempt to label their coordinated lie as a "strategic alibi check" is a desperate cover-up, and their continued fabrication about Modi refusing to specify a location—when he clearly stated Medbay—proves they are impostors trying to control the narrative.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: Nina and Judy are clearly acting in lockstep to frame multiple people, first Charlie and now me, and their "strategic alibi check" is just a transparent cover-up for their coordinated lies.
